review_locator: PMCID:PMC8013977, Transcription Factors Associated With IL-15 Cytokine Signaling During NK Cell Development; PMCID:PMC5761663, Group 1 innate lymphoid cell lineage identity is determined by a cis-regulatory element marked by a long non-coding RNA
primary_title: The Helix-Loop-Helix Protein ID2 Governs NK Cell Fate by Tuning Their Sensitivity to Interleukin-15; Group 1 innate lymphoid cell lineage identity is determined by a cis-regulatory element marked by a long non-coding RNA
decision_basis: The review-guided primary set shows IL-15 induces Id2 in NK/group-1 ILC contexts and that STAT5-dependent regulatory activity is required for Id2 induction and NK-cell maturation/homeostasis.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-15-associated ID2 expression/homeostasis bridge; retain the STAT5 and NK/group-1 ILC context without terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC8013977, Transcription Factors Associated With IL-15 Cytokine Signaling During NK Cell Development; PMCID:PMC6293989, The IL-15-AKT-XBP1s signaling pathway contributes to effector functions and survival in human NK cells
primary_title: The IL-15-AKT-XBP1s signaling pathway contributes to effector functions and survival in human NK cells
decision_basis: The review-guided primary studies show IL-15 increases GZMB expression in NK cells, with STAT5 binding at the GZMB promoter and an IL-15-AKT-XBP1s/T-BET effector context; cytotoxicity and GZMB protein outputs were measured in primary NK cells.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-15-associated GZMB gene/protein effector bridge; retain the mixed transcriptional-regulator context and do not add a terminal-TF claim.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC8013977, Transcription Factors Associated With IL-15 Cytokine Signaling During NK Cell Development; PMCID:PMC7773031, Divergent Role for STAT5 in the Adaptive Responses of Natural Killer Cells
primary_title: STAT5 Is a Key Regulator in NK Cells and Acts as a Molecular Switch from Tumor Surveillance to Tumor Promotion
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-15-containing stimulation activates STAT5, increases STAT5 occupancy at the Vegfa promoter and is associated with reduced Vegfa transcription in NK cells; STAT5-deficient NK cells produce enhanced VEGFA.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-15/STAT5-associated VEGFA repression bridge; preserve the co-stimulation and NK-cell context and the inhibitory direction.
